description: Implementation of VirtualTouchpadService class handling touchpad interactions and permissions in Android DVR namespace.

classes.name: VirtualTouchpadService
classes.description: Service class managing virtual touchpad input and permissions.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a client to the touchpad service after permission check.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the current client from the touchpad service.

methods.name: touch
methods.description: Sends touch input data to the touchpad.

methods.name: buttonState
methods.description: Updates button state on the touchpad.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Sends scroll input to the touchpad.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the service for debugging.

methods.name: CheckPermissions
methods.description: Verifies if the caller has the correct permissions and is the owner.

methods.name: CheckTouchPermission
methods.description: Checks if the caller has restricted VR access permission.
